title: ClassicalRawLisseOperations
statement: For the normalized finite classical raw realization data [def-zl-classical-raw-lisse-realization-data], define the operation datum as follows. Finite coefficient extension is a functor on finite-free systems whose levels are the sheafified balanced tensors of the actual ramification-indexed quotients, and a functor on their raw scalar localizations with the coefficient-inclusion fraction formula. Locally closed restriction is etale inverse image on every finite level, rationalized on every fraction. Their comparison squares are those of the normalized ordinary module realization. Their defining comparisons prescribe the tensor and pulled-back-section maps. These are finite-stage operation data; no existence is asserted. For scalar extension, the finite unit is the balanced tensor unit followed by sheafification and the inverse level identification. For restriction it is the actual etale pullback adjunction unit followed by that identification. These units commute with every quotient transition. The integral unit is uniquely pinned by all inverse-limit completion projections, using the canonical site-comparison adjoint mate for restriction. After the finite object identifications, the ordinary comparison carries the localization of every lattice section, tensored with one (and pulled back with the actual module unit), to the localization of that integral completion-cone map. Thus the ordinary and raw comparisons are fixed maps, not arbitrary natural isomorphisms. The coefficient, category, site and realization interfaces used here are those of [def-per-site-comparison-pullback-data], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], [def-real-lisse-realization-data], [def-real-lisse-tensor-normalization], [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data].
